messages:
Aisha Khan: Acme SSO just asked for an attachable evidence package showing: ephemeral support sessions, redacted SIEM export, and KMS proxy behavior. Can we assemble?

Tom Becker: I can make the SIEM ndjson sample and HMAC it. We must redact tenant IDs and remove IPs.

Lena Park: I'll draft the KMS line: support never sees KEK; platform performs ops via proxy with truncated key IDs logged.

Tom Becker: Example ndjson (redacted):
{"ts":"2026-03-09T11:00:00Z","svc":"auth","evt":"session.create","actor":"support:tbecker","session":"s-77a","tenant":"<TENANT_REDACTED>","ttl":900}
{"ts":"2026-03-09T11:00:05Z","svc":"auth","evt":"session.authorize","session":"s-77a","role":"support-impersonate","result":"ok"}
{"ts":"2026-03-09T11:15:00Z","svc":"auth","evt":"session.expire","session":"s-77a","reason":"ttl"}

Tom Becker: HMAC command to produce signature: `openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$ACME_VERIF_KEY" -binary sample.ndjson | base64`

Lena Park: Add this KMS blurb: "KMS proxying: platform performs Encrypt/Decrypt calls; logs include operation and truncated key fingerprint (sha256:abcd...). Support roles cannot unwrap customer keys. Private deployments may use HSM-backed keys."

security-bot: Note: audit retention configurable; default 365d.

Aisha Khan: Great. Deliverable: cover note + zip(sample.ndjson, signature.txt, verification_instructions.txt, kms_blurb.txt). Use secure share; don't send verification key in the same channel. Target: EOD.
